forum.title: Please confirm the origin country​ of the STSPIN9P15TR
forum.best_answer_content:
Welcome @andreaspan, to the community!

Typically, you will find the COO information (country of origin) on the respective product website under the tab **Sample & Buy**, so in your case under [STSPIN9P15TR](https://www.st.com/en/motor-drivers/stspin9p15.html#sample-buy) or [STSPIN9P23TR](https://www.st.com/en/motor-drivers/stspin9p23.html#sample-buy).

If no information can be found there yet, you can always contact the personal [ST Online Support](https://ols.st.com).

Hope that helps?

Regards

/Peter
